scenario: Original demo Co3Sn2S2 crystal; CPU offline XrayExperimentSPEC; actual organizer-owned initial state frozen
input: Known CIF, commanded motor status, native sample-information query, detector exposures and ROI scans
output: Sequential native actions; orientation estimate formed by original or0/or1 reflections; finish returns native symmetry-aware relative angle

wh.description: Read the current commanded motor positions.

get_sample_information.description: Read the known crystal structure and theoretical diffraction information.

umv.description: Move one or more motors to absolute angles in degrees. Motor names are direct keys inside arguments. Omitted motors keep their current values.

pd_exposure.description: Acquire one detector exposure at the current motor positions.

dscan.description: Scan one motor between start and finish offsets relative to its current position, in degrees. Both endpoints plus the current position must be within the motor range in task_index.json. intervals is the number of exposure points, including endpoints, and spends that many exposures.

start.description: Starting offset in degrees relative to the current motor position.

finish.description: Finishing offset in degrees relative to the current motor position.

intervals.description: Number of exposure points, including both endpoints.

or0.description: Record the first indexed reflection at the current motor positions. H, K and L are separate numeric arguments. Use reflections identified from measurements; this call does not acquire an exposure.

or1.description: Record the second indexed reflection at the current motor positions and calculate the orientation when the reference geometry is valid. Choose a nonparallel reflection and appropriate motor positions based on measurements. This call does not acquire an exposure.

finish.description: End the episode permanently and read the native orientation score. No arguments; remains available after the command budget.

budgets.source: Task73 fixed acquisition allowance, not claimed original paper budget

scoring.metric: Original symmetry-aware relative angle in degrees; lower is better
scoring.native_behavior: Native acos linear extrapolation makes identity angle slightly nonzero; preserved

access: Only public/ and serialized action responses visible. Organizer owns simulator, hidden offsets, RNG and scoring. Run one isolated organizer process per episode; this adapter is not an OS sandbox.
limitations: One original demo configuration, not all paper hardware/agent benchmarks
No physical instrument, training, LLM, API or action optimization during preparation
Native simulator uses fixed Gaussian motor offsets and stochastic detector effects; actual state and RNG are frozen
Tested compatible CPU dependency versions are pinned separately from upstream broad UI/API requirements
invocation: Pass each action example directly as simulator_action tool input. arguments_schema describes the exact keys inside arguments; argument names are case-sensitive. Examples illustrate syntax, not an optimized measurement plan.
response_notes: A top-level error reports an argument or adapter failure. Native operations may instead return observation.result.success=false and a message; inspect that result before continuing.
A syntactically accepted or0/or1 call can fail when reference geometry is invalid. Call examples do not guarantee a scientifically valid orientation.
